title: Archive
intro: Earlier projects, kept here as short previews rather than full case studies. Open one for the gist and a few screens.

projects.hook: A tablet app that suggests faster, greener and cheaper routes to pilots in flight.
projects.summary: Collins licensed NASA's TASAR algorithm, which had saved fuel and time in trials with Alaska Airlines, and needed to turn it into an app pilots would actually use across its EFB products. As design lead I shaped the layout, look and feel and interactions, and managed a second designer. We validated the designs in 31 interviews and usability tests before development.
delivered: An app that works in portrait and landscape, with a split-screen mode for running two apps
An experience map of in-flight rerouting between pilots, dispatchers and air traffic control
A component library that kept design, engineering and QA in step
projects.outcome: Pilots rated FPO 4.8 out of 5 for usefulness.

projects.hook: A ground-up, responsive redesign of WWE.com, the hub for millions of wrestling fans.
projects.summary: The old site had fragmented content, wasn't responsive and couldn't produce usable analytics. We rebuilt it around video and storytelling, with immersive landing pages for legacy matches, superstars and championships, and a clearer path into WWE Network. The goal was longer viewing sessions and more Network subscriptions.
delivered: Landing pages that mix panoramic visuals, timelines, video highlights and stats
A responsive component library, themed for Raw, SmackDown, NXT and WrestleMania
A style guide and image-crop specs for WWE's editorial and photo teams

projects.hook: One modern look for the ABA's 30-plus websites, made to appeal to the next generation of lawyers.
projects.summary: The ABA's digital board needed a consistent look across more than 30 sites, and a fresher one for younger lawyers. I explored how color, type, illustration and data visualization could modernize a respected institution, and with a team of three designed the pages that became the new brand's design system. Navigation centered on a feed of story cards, so people could find content faster.
delivered: A brand design system of type, color, interaction animation and layouts
A responsive library of feed components that editors use to build each section
Feature pages for the busiest sections: events, CLE courses, legal news and the store

projects.hook: A video-led news app for iPhone and iPad, made to reach a new audience.
projects.summary: The BBC News digital team wanted a video-first experience that would bring in, and hold, a new audience. Within the BBC News guidelines, we explored two directions that shaped the news around the time of day: the commute, lunch, longer evening stories and breaking news. We tested and iterated on browsing habits and autoplay.
delivered: Two design directions for iPhone and iPad, tested against how people browse
Active and passive viewing modes, with passive playing the news hands-free
A smart queue that let editors add and update news chapters through the day

projects.hook: A new way to explore Rockwell Group's hotel and hospitality work.
projects.summary: Rockwell Group, an interior design firm, wanted its hospitality projects to invite exploration across many hotel brands. I redesigned the hospitality page, the entry point to its restaurants, lobbies, stages and other spaces, around a modular grid. Stark, minimal styling kept the imagery and stories in front.
delivered: A modular grid of brands that works at every breakpoint
A dark landing page that hands off to light detail pages, for contrast
Project detail pages that lead with photography and story
